## 中文

### 修复与改进

- 修复不同 Zotero 版本的 PDF Worker 协议兼容问题，支持 Zotero 11。PDF 识别、全文提取和整篇渲染校验分别设置 30 秒超时，避免请求卡住共享队列；识别失败时仍可使用文件名匹配。
- 重做附件匹配：优先使用明确的文章 DOI，区分不同版本，结合 PDF 元数据、首页标题排版和文件名综合判断。不再按短标题优先强行配对；低相似度、DOI 冲突或候选不明确时跳过并保留源文件，避免连锁错配。
- 保留标题中的关键数字与否定词，并区分正文、补充材料和勘误，避免仅因 DOI 相同就把补充文件当作正文。
- 同一条目已有相同 PDF 的 Zotero 存储附件或外部链接附件时，跳过重复添加并保留下载文件。除字节完全一致的文件外，在允许读取 PDF 时，还可通过 DOI、页数、完整文本及逐页渲染结果校验重新编码的副本；校验失败或超时不会判为重复。

### 验证

- 使用真实的 133 条 RIS 元数据与 28 个 PDF 测试：27 篇不同文章全部正确匹配，1 个重复副本跳过，无错配或漏配；再次执行不重复添加。该结果仅代表此测试样本，不是对所有文献的准确率保证。

---

## English

### Fixes And Improvements

- Fixed PDF Worker protocol compatibility across Zotero versions, including Zotero 11. Recognition, full-text extraction, and whole-document render verification each have a 30-second deadline to avoid blocking the shared worker queue; filename matching remains available when recognition fails.
- Reworked attachment matching to prioritize unambiguous article DOIs, distinguish editions, and combine PDF metadata, first-page title layout, and filenames. Short titles no longer receive greedy priority. Low-confidence, conflicting, or ambiguous candidates are skipped with their source files preserved, preventing cascading mismatches.
- Preserved meaningful numbers and negation in titles, and distinguished main articles, supporting information, and corrections so a shared DOI alone cannot misclassify a supporting document as the article.
- Skipped duplicate PDFs already attached to the same item as stored or linked files, while keeping the downloads. In addition to exact-byte checks, PDF reading can verify re-encoded copies through DOI, page count, complete text, and rendering results for every page. Failed or timed-out verification never establishes a duplicate.

### Verification

- Tested with 133 real RIS records and 28 PDFs: all 27 distinct articles matched correctly, one duplicate copy was skipped, and there were no incorrect or missed matches. A second run added no duplicates. These results apply to this sample only, not to every possible publication.
